_comment: Repository-controlled default raw-genre -> preferred-genre mappings for CrateIQ Genre Intelligence (Phase 3). Keys are matched after deterministic normalization (casefold, whitespace/hyphen/underscore collapse, punctuation strip except '&'). A repository default mapping is only tier 3 in the resolver precedence: an explicit enabled user mapping (tier 1) or an exact enabled preferred-genre name match (tier 2) always wins first. Entries with "needs_review": true intentionally do not collapse a generic/ambiguous raw label (e.g. 'afro', 'dance') into a specific preferred genre; a user may still override any of these with an explicit manual mapping. This file is never written to by the app -- user mappings live in the local index (genre_mappings table).
